title: 多智能体自主性突破与AI基础设施投资激增，Q1创投达3000亿美元历史新高
core_insight: 多智能体系统自主性研究取得显著进展，同时AI基础设施投资创历史记录，显示产业从单点模型能力向系统级智能和算力基础建设全面演进

dimension_texts.technology: 多智能体系统自主性研究取得进展，研究表明LLM智能体在最小协调下可自发形成复杂社会组织结构 多智能体自组织架构开始挑战传统层级设计，PAR²-RAG提出主动检索与推理结合的新RAG范式 Drop the Hierarchy and Roles: How Self-Organizing LLM Agents Outperform Designed Structures PAR²-RAG: Planned Active Retrieval and Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering Towards Computational Social Dynamics of Semi-Autonomous AI Agents
dimension_texts.infrastructure: NVIDIA发布统一模型优化库，集成量化、剪枝等技术优化推理效率 Meta大规模建设天然气电厂支持AI算力需求，Cognichip获6000万美元融资用AI设计AI芯片 NVIDIA / Model-Optimizer Meta's natural gas binge could power South Dakota Cognichip wants AI to design the chips that power AI, and just raised $60M to try
dimension_texts.application: 银行业AI应用深化，Gradient Labs为银行客户提供AI账户经理；Slack集成30项AI功能提升生产力 VideoLingo等项目展示AI对传统视频字幕工作的替代潜力 Gradient Labs gives every bank customer an AI account manager Salesforce announces an AI-heavy makeover for Slack, with 30 new features VideoLingo
dimension_texts.capital: Q1全球创投达3000亿美元历史新高，AI计算和前沿实验室投资驱动 AI芯片设计公司Cognichip获6000万美元融资，显示硬件赛道热度 大厂持续投入基础设施，Meta建设大型数据中心，Anthropic处理源代码泄露事件 Q1 2026 Shatters Venture Funding Records As AI Boom Pushes Startup Investment To $300B Cognichip wants AI to design the chips that power AI, and just raised $60M to try Anthropic took down thousands of GitHub repos trying to yank its leaked source code
